meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会多出邮件通道:复制并注册 Resend 适配器、安装依赖,引导你填好密钥和发件信息,再把你的邮箱设为所有者并发来问候邮件,你就能用邮件和它聊天了。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Resend 邮件通道或配置邮件集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 Resend,以后能用邮件和你聊天。
say.note: 会开始复制适配器并配置凭据。

say.text: 我的邮箱是 me@example.com,设为所有者。
say.note: 会把你注册为所有者并发送问候邮件。

say.text: 用文件夹 my-agent 接收我的邮件回复。
say.note: 会把邮件绑定到指定 agent 组。

howto.what_en: This skill makes NanoClaw reachable via email through Resend. It copies and registers the Resend adapter, installs the dependency, prompts for your credentials, wires your address as owner, and sends you a hello.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Resend email channel or configure email integration.

say_en.text: Add Resend so I can chat via email.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and configuring credentials.
Registers you as owner and sends a hello.

say_en.text: Use folder my-agent for my email replies.
say_en.note: Binds email to that agent group.
